metadata.content: Today on Sky Sports Racing: Newcastle, Worcester and Yarmouth | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Today on Sky Sports Racing: Newcastle, Worcester and Yarmouth Nigel and Willy Twiston-Davies' talented hurdler Potters Charm tries his hand at chasing for the first time in a potentially hot Novices’ Chase at Worcester; we also have competitive action from Worcester and Yarmouth, live on Sky Sports Racing from 1.37pm Saturday 10 October 2026 18:19, UK Image: Worcester is the venue for today's live action over jumps We have a busy day's racing on Monday with action from Newcastle, Worcester and Yarmouth, live on Sky Sports Racing... 3.07 Worcester - Potters Charm makes chasing debut Potters Charm makes his chasing debut in the Paul Ferguson's Jumpers to Follow Novices' Chase at Worcester. He found it tough when pitched into open company last season after only losing once in his novice campaign but got back to winning ways in January at Windsor before scoring at Grade Two level in the National Spirit Hurdle at Fontwell. Connections have always been optimistic of him doing his best work over fences so they will be hoping for a successful chasing debut, clearly being the one to beat.
